label: Train exploratory paired comparison
scope: 58 held-group Train episodes; four arms; no Selection/Calibration/Test access

exploratory_gate.rule: work order section 4: hybrid q sensor-macro NRMSE at least 5% below same-queue RTTC, hybrid q raw MAE not above RTTC, hybrid o sensor-macro NRMSE not above same-queue G80; used only to schedule future research, not a promotion gate

g80_vs_g40_sensor_nrmse_relative_reducti.note: G80 improves q on 58/58 episodes per prior diagnostics; the research aspiration of >=5% q improvement is NOT met by ~4.66% and must not be reported as reached

exploratory_disclaimer: All 58 episodes were exposed to G40 retention and subsequent exploration, and 5 episodes overlap the RTTC parameter-selection set; every ranking here is a Train exploratory paired comparison and must not promote G80, the hybrid arm, or claim general superiority over RTTC or any held-out evaluation.
